purpose: Second falsification-oriented Weltformel/MMSI validation stage. This experiment tests whether the already-frozen four-channel thermodynamic research-load model produces a higher sustained stored-load state during a cognitively demanding Stroop task than during matched relaxed baseline in independent public Muse S EEG. It is not a test of physical universality.

hypothesis_origin.model_interpretation: The frozen model treats wRaw as a leaky, flow-gated stored research-load state driven by EEG-derived frictionRate. A sustained cognitively demanding task is preregistered to yield higher sustained wRaw than relaxed baseline.
explicit_nonclaims: WF02 does not validate OMEGA_KRIT=5800 as a biological threshold.
WF02 does not validate pressureProxy as measured mechanical vascular pressure.
WF02 does not establish diagnosis, disease specificity, causality, entropic gravity, metaphysical claims, universality, or a physical law.

source.dataset: CogWear: Can we detect cognitive effort with consumer-grade wearables?
source.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0
source.cohort_rule: Use every pilot participant id 0 through 10 with both baseline/muse_eeg.csv and cognitive_load/muse_eeg.csv in the frozen PhysioNet v1.0.0 release. No participant may be removed based on MMSI outcomes.

conditions.baseline: Three-minute relaxed baseline with no task.

source.data_identity_rule: At runtime, read the exact path's SHA-256 from PhysioNet v1.0.0 SHA256SUMS.txt and reject the downloaded file before analysis unless the local SHA-256 matches.

equations.flowGate: eFlow / (1 + eFlow), with non-finite/negative safety coercions frozen in engine
equations.loadEvolution: dW/dt = frictionRate - frictionRate*flowGate - (W/recoveryTau)*flowGate; Euler update; W clipped at >=0

input_mapping.record_policy: Use every non-empty CSV record after the header in source order. A non-empty record with fewer than 25 columns is a hard failure.
input_mapping.non_numeric_policy: Represent empty or non-numeric raw EEG cells as NaN exactly as in the existing CogWear adapter. The frozen load engine's >=99.5% finite-input rule remains unchanged.
input_mapping.condition_window_rule: For each condition use exactly the first 46080 source-order EEG rows (180.0 s at 256 Hz). If either condition cannot supply 46080 rows, the participant is NOT_ANALYZABLE and remains reported; no replacement window is permitted.

primary_endpoint.name: sustained_last_minute_raw_load
primary_endpoint.condition_score: Median wRaw across ThermodynamicLoadPoint values with timeSeconds >= 120.0 after running the unchanged engine on the matched first 180.0 seconds.
primary_endpoint.directional_hypothesis: CogWear Stroop cognitive_load subject scores are higher than matched baseline subject scores.
primary_endpoint.group_test: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank, one-sided alternative cognitive_load > baseline, zero_method='wilcox', correction=false, asymptotic normal approximation.
primary_endpoint.success_rule: Primary supported only if p_one_sided <= 0.05 and median(delta_sustained_W) > 0.

secondary_predeclared_endpoints: descriptive count of omegaBreach in each condition; this is not a confirmatory test of OMEGA_KRIT

parity_gate.requirement: For every analyzable participant and both conditions, Kotlin ThermodynamicLoadEngine output must match an independently implemented Python oracle on the exact matched 180-second source window before group inference.
parity_gate.comparison: Compare every emitted ThermodynamicLoadPoint field in order and all ThermodynamicLoadAnalysis summary fields.

missingness_and_failures.analyzability_rule: A pair is analyzable only if both verified source files satisfy the frozen input mapping and the unchanged Kotlin/Python engines produce finite parity-matched outputs.
missingness_and_failures.inference_rule: Primary inference uses all analyzable preregistered participant pairs. Any NOT_ANALYZABLE participant and exact reason are retained in the group artifact.
missingness_and_failures.no_imputation: No outcome-driven row deletion, interpolation, channel substitution, alternate time window, participant replacement, parameter tuning, or threshold tuning is permitted.

guardrails: No WF02 thermodynamic-load result may be inspected before this preregistration commit exists.

No participant, condition, channel, source column, duration, window, hop, recovery tau, endpoint definition, direction, statistical test, alpha, or parity tolerance may change after outcomes are observed.
A negative primary result is retained unchanged and counts against generalization of the frozen thermodynamic research-load interpretation.
A positive primary result supports one narrow paired cognitive-load prediction only.
OMEGA_KRIT=5800 and pressureProxy remain research model parameters/proxies and are not validated by WF02 even if descriptive values differ.
